headline: Indians' Chapman Struck by Pitch; Condition Critical
dispatch: Cleveland Indians shortstop Ray Chapman was struck in the left temple by a fastball delivered by Yankees pitcher Carl Mays at the Polo Grounds in New York on August 16, 1920. Chapman collapsed at the plate and was carried from the field. He died early the following morning, the only player in Major League Baseball history to die directly from injuries suffered during a game.
answer: Ray Chapman fatally struck by pitched ball in New York, 1920
